finite_endpoint_definition.status: Explicit saved-Q/L finite candidate endpoint two-jet, not an exact radial-solution jet
finite_endpoint_definition.source_error_scope: Only finite inverse/projection discrepancy at the saved candidate mean; R44 separately restores the true complete mean and computes the actual candidate defect
finite_endpoint_definition.source_coordinate: The same original endpoint source x used by r_x and ell
finite_endpoint_definition.mathematical_candidate_definition: All binary Q/L are exact stored constants; H=r^4Q and Kbar=sqrt2*L_nonmean-P_theta on the fixed real source. Kbar_x is the saved-mode projection of the stated finite inverse-polynomial PDE expression.
